tools.name: fetch_gtin
tools.description: What is this GTIN? Returns the signed record for a GTIN-8/12/13/14: product, brand, maker, category and pack where a source page states them, each with the pages it was read from and the date it was read; seen_in markets and banners; confidence confirmed (two or more independent domains agree) or se

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fetch_gtin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What is this GTIN? Returns the signed record for a GTIN-8/12/13/14: product, brand, maker, category and pack where a source page states them, each with the pages it was read from and the date it was read; seen_in markets and banners; confidence confirmed (two or more independent domains agree) or se" → after: "What is this GTIN? findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
